name: The Stig
description: Some say his blood type is 98 RON, and that he has never once looked for a parking space. Nobody knows his name. Everybody knows his lap times.
creator: bnuuy

bonuses.description: +2% to every stat — every car, every track. Some say he doesn't know the word 'specialist'
+3 handling in the Rain — some say water simply declines to slow him down
+3 mra off the tarmac — some say he thinks gravel is asphalt that isn't trying
-3% 0-60 on Drag strips — some say he reacts to green lights before they've decided
+2% to every stat as the underdog — some say he has never noticed being outgunned
+5 handling and +4 mra at the Top Gear Test Track. Flat through the Follow-Through
